svg.title: One stuck shard: 2 to 6 failed starts in the hold, back 19 to 23 s after the restore
svg.desc: A lane a raun of faults/catalog.yaml's stuck-shard on a compose cell, which moves one shard's range_id column in the cell's Postgres past the range id the shard holds and puts it back at removal, held 120 s; the last lane is stuck-shard-norestore, whose removal does nothing. Across, seconds from the bump, the raun's inject_at. The first tick is the signal landing, the shard's closes counted since just before the bump; the first dashed line is the removal, remove_at; the diamond the shard's "Acquired shard" after it; the second dashed line the raun's budget, 90 s after the removal; the fine dashed line the self-test's cleanup restore. Each bar is a window holding its failed client starts, left to right: during, from the landing to the hold's end; drain, from the removal to the after window; after. The self-test's drain has no recorded end and is drawn to the cleanup, faint. Below, the readings of the before and during windows of all 4 rauns, the range over them, completions a second computed from each window's count and seconds. Sources: docs/tables/fig-stuck-shard.jsonl, docs/tables/rauns.jsonl, docs/tables/src/hosts.tsv.
